p.uicontrol: Keep your eyes on the road and drive carefully.

conbody.p: Forward Attention Warning determines whether the driver is focused on the road according to information such as the amount of time the driver is looking elsewhere, the amount of time the eyes are closed, and so on. If it determines the driver is not focused, an audible warning sounds for about 1 second, and the Forward attention warning light () appears on the cluster until the conditions to turn it off are met.

In addition, if it detects the driver is drowsy or sleeping, the Forward Attention Warning can alert you with a warning message and steering wheel vibration, along with the warning sound and warning light.

li.p: When the driver’s gaze is not focused on the road continuously for several seconds while driving above 20 km/h (12mph).
When glances away from the road occur repeatedly for several seconds while driving above 20 km/h (12 mph).
When the driver’s eyes are closed for several seconds while driving above 10 km/h (6 mph), the system may determine that the driver is drowsy or sleeping.
When the driver looks forward continuously for several seconds.
When the operating conditions are not met.
When driving below the warning activation speed.
